## Project Overview

This is a simple HTML/CSS static website repository. It's designed as a learning repository for GitHub features like forking and pull requests.

## Code Style and Standards

### HTML
- Use semantic HTML5 elements where appropriate
- Maintain proper indentation (2 spaces)
- Use lowercase for all HTML tags and attributes
- Include proper DOCTYPE declaration
- Always close tags properly

### CSS
- Follow consistent spacing and indentation
- Use descriptive class and ID names
- Group related CSS properties together
- Keep selectors simple and maintainable
- Avoid inline styles; keep styles in separate CSS files

### General
- Keep file structure simple and organized
- Maintain consistency with existing code style
- Ensure all links and references are correct

## Documentation

- Update README.md when making significant changes to the project
- Include clear commit messages that describe what changed and why
- Document any new features or functionality

## Best Practices

- Test all HTML changes by opening in a browser
- Validate HTML and CSS using standard validators when possible
- Keep the codebase accessible and beginner-friendly
- Maintain backward compatibility with existing functionality
